title: Big data, cloud, edge & data centres
quote: Edge = lowest latency; fog = in between; cloud = distant centres

boxes.title: Big data
items: ==Large volumes of high-velocity, complex, variable data== (APPSC 2019)
**Data warehouse**: cleaned, structured; **data lake**: raw, native

levels.name: Cloud
levels.note: Distant centralised data centres; heavy analytics

levels.name: Fog
levels.note: Between edge and cloud; local aggregation

items: **PUE** = facility ÷ IT energy; closer to **1** better
